ca_bat_rock_the_original_route.skip_reason: identity in doubt: the only 'Original Route' page found is at Cougar Crag West, and the Bat Rock page lists three climbs, none confirmed as this one

set.descent_text: Rappel from the top down to the level where Hanshi joins What's Up Bubb, then follow that route's rappels to the base. The lower pitches carry fixed rappel stations, so the descent follows bolted anchors the whole way down.

review.notes: Route page gives the rappel line via What's Up Bubb; the 2016 report confirms fixed rap stations on the lower part. No rappel count given (not agreed).
